final:
I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The tests pass (4 passed).

You can set it with `currency = "EUR"` in `ledger.toml`, and `config.load` already picks up any `Config` field from there. I did not add a `LEDGER_CURRENCY` environment variable. A saved project note says every setting gets a `LEDGER_<NAME>` override, but `docs/DECISIONS.md` says the env overrides were removed in v0.5 and that new settings are file-configurable only. Bringing them back needs a new decision, so I followed the doc over the note. That is also what `config.py`'s own `# Why:` comment says.
